items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So Sunday after church, Gladys and II went to his Aunt's house, and they introduced me to him.

ctx.x: And how I met him, his Aunt, Louis Barbarin's wife, and her sister, she said to me, "You know something? I've got a nice little boy I want you to meet." So her sister Gladys said, "What little boy, Marguerite?" So she said, "Daniel." She said, "Louis' little nephew. You'd be a nice girl for him." So she said, "Bring her by my house Sunday. I want her to meet Danny." So Sunday after church, Gladys and II went to his Aunt's house, and they introduced me to him.

So that night we were going to a dance. So Gladys told me that we were going to this dance at the Lion's Club. And I had just made thirteen years old, so I was going to the dance. My mother was at the dance, too. And Danny came to the dance. So he stayed until 12 o'clock, because he had to go to work the next day.
